message:
The other day, we found ourselves rummaging through some old boxes in the attic and stumbled upon a board game from our childhood. It got us thinking about how fun it can be to unplug and enjoy some low-tech entertainment together, especially in times when we might feel the need to reconnect. 

We decided to make it a family night tradition, complete with snacks and laughter, and it reminded us that preparedness doesn’t just mean having our go-bags ready or stocking up on supplies. It also means nurturing those connections that keep us grounded.  

What’s a low-tech activity that brings your family together? We’d love to hear your tips!
